messages:
Ivy (AE): NewBridge Financial asked for a 6mo pilot on Private: requesting 28% off list, waive onboarding, and ability to convert to 12mo at a discounted rate. They need PO by Tue.
Marco (RevOps): what’s their config list price?
Ivy (AE): private VPC, reserved 2xA100 equiv, premium support = $125k/mo. 28% -> $90k/mo.
Samir (Security): they submitted SOC2 + custom egress controls. Will need completed attestation and IP allowlist before go-live. Reduced logging ask is non-starter; we can document retention exceptions but need tradeoffs in SOW.
Jo (Eng): capacity ok but reserved machines require ~12 business days. Fast path: start on shared infra then migrate to dedicated in ~7-10 days.
Ivy (AE): drafting two proposals to present tonight:
Option 1: 25% off pilot, onboarding fee waived, conversion window 45d, conversion credit = dollar credit equal to 50% of pilot invoices (capped $120k) applied to first invoice after conversion.
Option 2: 20% off with 12mo commit, $25k onboarding credit, and $15k/mo compute-offset credits for pilot spikes.
Marco (RevOps): finance floor for an unconstrained pilot is 22%. 25% is allowable only with deal-desk conditional approval + hard PO deadline + signed conversion intent.
Ivy (AE): can we attach conditions: PO by Tue EOD (3790012368), signed conversion intent within pilot period, and security attestation uploaded within 10 days?
Samir (Security): yes, include clause: "Onboarding waiver contingent on receipt of completed security attestation and network allowlist within 10 days; service start subject to security acceptance."
LegalBot: recommended language tweak: spell out credit application: "Conversion credit: dollar credit equal to 50% of total pilot invoices, capped at $120,000, applied to the first post-conversion invoice; non-transferable."
Jo (Eng): operational note: if onboarding fee waived, include "standard onboarding scheduled within 5 business days; expedited migration available at published ops rates."
Marco (RevOps): I can provision a one-time conditional 25% pilot approval if those 3 conditions are met. I'll open a deal-desk ticket and mark it conditional — if any condition fails discount is void and billing reverts to standard pricing.
Ivy (AE): perfect — I'll send the term sheet with LegalBot wording and add the compute-offset as a dollar line item.
Ivy (AE): (later) forwarded procurement email: "We are pushing PO, aiming for Tue but may slip."
Marco (RevOps): escalate to deal-desk now with conditional approval. Add margin guardrails and conversion cap.
Samir (Security): I'll prioritize questionnaire review once uploaded. Ping me.
Ivy (AE): thanks team — will post final signed PO here when it arrives. :crossed_fingers:
